description:
List the AQUAVIEW data sources you can pull actual rows from, or describe one in detail.

Call this BEFORE get_data on a source you have not used. Variable names are
canonical per source and cannot be guessed — this is where they come from.

With an API key, sources your account is entitled to appear here too.

Args:
    source_id: Omit to list every visible source. Give one (e.g. "gadr") to get its
        full detail: canonical variable names, units, row limits, and filterable columns.
    output_format: 'csv' (compact, default), 'json', or 'toon'.
name: list_data_sources
